items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: And Santiago too, Willie Santiago, he played too at that time. They all used to hire them, different band would hire them

ctx.x: You know him? Eddie Johnson. I've heard of him, yes.
You know Santiago? Yes. Well, that's his brother-in-law. That's his brother-in-law. I was mixed up.
You were talking about Jones was the bass player.
